jobs.title: Account Manager, Rokt Ads Japan
jobs.description:
We are Rokt. We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We’ve built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped.

The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.

At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation, which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability. 

Target total compensation ranges from  ¥15,300,000 – ¥18,800,000JPY, including a fixed annual salary of  ¥12,250,000 – ¥15,000,000JPY, variable quarterly compensation, an employee equity plan grant, and world-class benefits. This is the expected range for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.

Equity grants are issued in good faith, subject to company policies, board approval, and individual eligibility.

About the role: 

As an Account Manager for Rokt Ads, you will help solve the problem of the Japanese local advertisers to expand their market reach via Rokt Thanks’ network available in Japan by supporting advertisers to launch, optimize, and scale campaigns that deliver measurable outcomes through Rokt Ads.  Based in Tokyo, you will work closely with clients and cross-functional partners to execute campaigns with excellence, identify trends and irregularities in performance data, and translate product capabilities into clear customer value.  This is a role designed for builders who are excited to learn fast, use AI and data to improve outcomes, and grow into managing broader client relationships over time.  The role is intentionally scoped to scale with company growth by building strong fundamentals in execution, product fluency, structured problem-solving, and adaptability as priorities evolve.

We are an AI-first company. We're a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and "someone should build a tool for that" is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn’t obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won’t like it here.

How your future team uses AI: 

The Account Management team uses AI as an account intelligence partner to synthesize customer activity, assess account health, and turn customer goals into measurable success plans. AI helps Account Managers identify risks and growth opportunities earlier, while CSMs apply the judgment, trust, and strategic leadership needed to strengthen relationships and drive outcomes.

AI supports the more hands-on technical side of the role as well, helping teams troubleshoot issues such as faulted integrations and get clients to answers faster. And increasingly, AI isn't just how we work—it's part of what we bring to our clients. 

How you will contribute: 

  • Support onboarding, launch, execution, and ongoing optimization of Rokt Ads campaigns for assigned clients, with increasing autonomy.
  • Analyze campaign and portfolio data to identify irregularities, major trends, and actionable insights, and communicate findings clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build confidence managing smaller accounts or discrete components of larger advertiser relationships, ensuring timely follow-through and strong operational execution.
  • Learn and apply AI-enhanced tools, automation, and Rokt product insights to improve campaign efficiency, reporting quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Partner effectively across Sales, Account Management, Ad Operations, Product, and other internal teams to solve problems quickly and adapt to changing business priorities.

Requirements

What you Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience in client success, account management, digital advertising, campaign management, performance marketing, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Solid experience using data, spreadsheets, reporting tools, or ad platforms to monitor performance and generate insights; experience with campaign management or marketing technology tools would be beneficial.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced teams, balancing multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • A builder mindset with humility, curiosity, and accountability; you proactively ask questions, seek feedback, and constantly look for better ways to improve and accelerate outcomes.
  • Good knowledge of digital advertising, ecommerce, campaign optimization, or customer performance metrics would be great, and an interest in using AI-driven tools to improve execution is highly valued.
  • Language requirements : Native level Japanese and Business level English.

Benefits

About Rokt’stars:

We move fast and decide with incomplete information, because a good decision this week can lead to a perfect one next quarter. We work as one team, which means the best idea wins regardless of who raised it or what level they are. We hire people who are brilliant and humble and who are obsessed with making the customer successful.

About The Benefits:

  • Subsidized Health Insurance
  • Equity in a profitable, fast-growing company approaching $1 Billion in revenue
  • Every employee has enterprise access to leading AI tools, building AI fluency as a core skill
  • Monthly Wellness and Cell Phone Allowances
  • Quarterly performance reviews for most roles, so feedback and promotion decisions don't wait
  • Extra leave (bonus annual leave, sabbatical leave etc.)

We believe we’re better together. Most teams are in the office minimum 4 days per week. 

At Rokt, we choose to create a company that is as diverse and inclusive as the world we live in by attracting, growing and keeping the best talent. Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If this sounds like a role you’d enjoy, apply here, and you’ll hear from our recruiting team.

Rokt only contacts candidates from @rokt.com addresses. We never request payment, bank details, or identity documents before a written offer, and we never interview solely over chat apps. Verify any role at rokt.com/careers if you're unsure.

jobs.title: AI Systems Specialist
jobs.description:
We are Rokt, a hyper-growth ecommerce leader. Rokt is the global leader in ecommerce, unlocking real-time relevance in the moment that matters most. Rokt’s AI Brain and ecommerce Network powers billions of transactions connecting hundreds of millions of customers, and is trusted to do this by the world’s leading companies.

We are a team of builders helping smart businesses find innovative ways to meet customer needs and generate incremental revenue. Leading companies drive 10-50% of additional revenue—and often all their profits—from the extra products or services they sell. This economic edge unleashes a world of possibilities for growth and innovation.

At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation. We believe in transparency, which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with transparent compensation and clear career paths based on competency and ability. Rokt’stars constantly strive to raise the bar, pushing the envelope of what is possible.

We are looking for a AI Systems Specialist

Target total compensation ranges from $157,000 - $214,000, including a fixed annual salary of $140,000 - $174,000, an employee equity plan grant, and world-class benefits. 

Equity grants are issued in good faith, subject to company policies, board approval, and individual eligibility.

About the Role:

We are looking for an AI Systems Specialist to join Rokt’s G&A Enablement team in New York City. This role will help support and improve our core business and financial systems while partnering with the Finance, Security, and People teams on workflows, automation and AI adoption.

You’ll work alongside experienced finance systems and enablement partners to keep daily operations running smoothly, improve system documentation, support user access and configuration, and identify practical ways to use AI and automation to reduce manual work. This is a hands-on role for someone early in their systems career who is curious, technically inclined, and excited to build.

Responsibilities:

Systems Ownership & Operations

  • Support the day-to-day operations, configuration, and continuous improvement of Rokt’s core business and finance systems including NetSuite
  • Manage system access, security roles, and user provisioning across core systems and platforms
  • Help maintain clean, reliable data and support controls across core workflows
  • Document system processes, support procedures, and common troubleshooting steps so teams can engage with core systems more effectively.
  • Monitor systems issues and partner with senior team members, vendors, IT, or engineering to resolve them.

AI & Automation

  • Use AI-enabled tools to improve documentation, testing, data review, workflow design, and automation.
  • Identify repeatable manual processes and help prototype practical improvements.
  • Support automation initiatives across financial and cross-functional systems and workflows
  • Learn and apply low-code, no-code, and AI-assisted development practices where appropriate.
  • Track and report on automation ROI

Cross-Functional Partnership

    • Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Legal, Security & People team to support cross functional workflows, systems integrations between adjacent systems and ensure seamless data flows.
    • Help translate business process needs into clear system requirements, documentation, and support plans.

Requirements

About you:

  • 3-5 years of experience in finance or business systems, consulting, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite administration and configuration is preferred but not required
  • Strong interest in finance technology, automation and AI-assisted ways of working.
  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, system exports/imports, and structured problem-solving.
  • Basic familiarity with APIs, scripting, SQL, JavaScript, or low-code tools is a plus, but deep engineering experience is not required.
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks
  • Clear communicator who can document processes and explain technical concepts to non-technical teams.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Curious, practical builder mindset: you like finding gaps, learning new systems, and improving how work gets done.

Benefits

About Rokt’stars:

As a mission-driven, hyper-growth community of curious explorers, our ambition is to unlock real-time relevancy in ecommerce and beyond. Our bias for action means we are not afraid to quickly venture into uncharted territories, take risks, or challenge the status quo; in doing so we either win or learn. We work together as one aligned team, never letting egos get in the way of brilliant ideas. We value diversity, transparency, and smart humble people who enjoy building a disruptive business together. We pride ourselves on being a force for good as we make the world better. 

About the Benefits:

We leverage best-in-class technology and market-leading innovation in AI and ML, with all of that being underlined by building and maintaining a fantastic and inclusive culture where people can be their authentic selves, and offering a great list of perks and benefits to go with it:

  • Become a shareholder. Every Rokt’star gets equity in the company
  • Enjoy catered lunch every day and healthy snacks in the office. Plus join the gym on us! 
  • Access generous retirement plans like a 4% dollar-for-dollar 401K matching plan and get fully funded premium health insurance!
  • Dog-friendly office
  • Extra leave (bonus annual leave, sabbatical leave etc.) 
  • Work with the greatest talent in town
  • See the world! We have offices in New York, Seattle, Sydney, Tokyo and London

We believe we’re better together. We love spending time together and are in the office most days (teams are in the office minimum 4 days per week).

We at Rokt choose to create a company that is as diverse and inclusive as the world we live in by attracting, growing & keeping the best talent. Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
